text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"......So at night, I just taaake it easy
and relax♪
Huh? You wanna see? Well then, maybe we
can all chill out together next time!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I think that's all for today's
livestream. And with that,
Love Me♡ Love You♡ This was Loves Only
You! See ya later~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dummy text for stream outro wipe playback.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Love-chan.
Um... is this a fan club livestream?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And Chrono-chan, speaking of
which... Ah!
It's that time, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for the newspaper... —...Now
then, the one-week-out workouts for this
week's
Nakayama main race are... Oh my, this
looks like it could be an upset."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The girl everyone called the favorite got
surprisingly low ratings from the
reporters...
The pace prediction says front-runners
have the advantage, but looking at the
stable's comments—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, spreading the newspaper out in a
place like this again~.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Eep...! S-Sorry, I couldn't wait any
longer... I'll head back to my room—
...Huh? A truck in front of the dorm
entrance...? I wonder what it's
delivering...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Futons and... pillows? That's quite a
lot... Ah!
Right, it's preparations for the new
students moving into the dorms!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
New students... It's that time of year
already, isn't it?
...Do you remember? Our first day moving
into the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hii☆ Starting today, we're roommates!
I'm Loves Only You. Nice to meetcha~♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Loves-san... My name is Chrono Genesis.
I may have my shortcomings, but... please
treat me well.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, Chrono Genesis-chan!
Oh, I'll help you unpack! I'm already all
done with mine.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you very much... I'm so
grateful...
Then, um... could you put the contents of
this cardboard box onto the bookshelf...?
I'm sorry to trouble you...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All of this is research material on
Umamusume races!
Whoa, you even have scrapbooks of Dubai
races! Hey, can I look?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Hm? There are marks here and there...
Wait, are these
predictions for the winning Umamusume?!
And they're actually right?! Wow, that's
amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it's nothing like that... I'm simply
gathering data, analyzing it,
and applying it to my own unique
methodology...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Predictions are also a form of observing
Umamusume racing history.
...I-It's just a hobby of mine... studying
the overall flow of history...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Your own original method? And it ties into
history? Sounds so fun~!
Hey, hey, tell me more about it,
Chrono-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so nostalgic! Oh yeah, that
happened!
Chrono talked about it so vividly after
that~♪

text_block_list.name: Radio Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
(...On that point, what are the Prime
Minister's thoughts?
Prime Minister... Sir. ...Regarding next
year's social security budget...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"......Good day, Gran-san.
Fufu, is that your usual... 'mile rule'?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bouquet-san! Good morn-mile☆
My Rule #3: "Relaxing with a radio
broadcast of the National Diet!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-san, what were you doing?
*sniff sniff*... You smell kinda nice,
don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—this fragrance.
I was thinking of making some dried
flowers and an herbarium.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today is dormitory move-in prep day,
right?
So, I thought I'd arrange some flowers for
the new students too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Dorm move-in prep day! Oh, so that's it! I
did wonder why everyone looked so busy!
Well theeen, I'll help out too!
Bouquet-san, just tell me what to do♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Woooow, Bouquet-san's arrangements really
are incredible!
The color balance is perfection! It's an
infinite mile of fabulousness!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, the new students at the Miho dorm
are definitely gonna be surprised♪
All the common areas look so gorgeous with
Bouquet-san's flowers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I'd be so happy...
Moving into the dorms means leaving your
parents and being all alone... It can get
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
When times are tough, when you want to
cry...
I hope this flower... can offer you even a
little bit of comfort...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope they can relax and make
themselves at home in the dorms as well.
Just like Gran-san does."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Gran-chan can stick to her own rules
wherever she goes, after all♪
Though for some girls, that's not so
easy."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I don't think I'm the only
one living by my own rules, you know♪
Look, for example—

"Tact-eeey!
Where are you?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, hey. Perfect timing, you two.
Have you seen tact around?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't seen her! But isn't she at the
usual spot?
Tact-san's personal rule activated☆"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The butterbur buds and lily bulbs
are almost ready too.
Let's leave them be a little longer until
they're good to eat.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I knew it!
You were off training in the mountains
again, tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san! Yes, I was scouting ahead.
The crops are growing quite well, so it
looks like we can hold a practical
hands-on learning session.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What? ...A preliminary inspection?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's a lecture for the new students.
I was thinking of teaching them survival
techniques.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Nature nurtures a healthy body and mind,
after all.
I'll do my best to become a dependable
senior just like Heart-san."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! You're amazing!
I'm sure you could give a great lecture,
tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But... make sure no new students wander
off and cause a panic, okay?
You have to guide them properly right to
the end, got it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for the trouble we caused
right after moving into the dorms back
then.
I'll be sure to tell her to always report
in whenever she goes out into the woods.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look at you making that senior face,
Tact-chan♪
Before we knew it, we've really settled
into the academy, haven't we~?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And eventually... we, too, just like
our seniors.
We will build our own era—and make
history...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Our era! Sounds great, sounds great♪
Then naturally, the mile belongs to my
era!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Upperclassmen, underclassmen, I'll blow
'em a~ll away!
And let everyone revel in the era of the
Mile Queen, Gran Alegria!
